question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108B ±2% (Aug 26, 2026). Over the last 5-6 quarters it beat the guidance midpoint by ~3.8-5.7% (Q2 FY27: $96.2B vs $91.0B guide, +5.7%), implying ~$111-115B with a median near $113B. Records at Taiwanese suppliers in Sep 2026 tied to the Rubin ramp support continued strength. Main downside: supply/shipment timing, China excluded. Upside escape above $116B needs a beat over 7.4%, uncommon but possible (~9%). Market check: a small Manifold market (4 holders, 18 trades) prices $110-112B 40%, $112-114B 26%, $114-116B 17%, >=$116B 10%, <$110B 8%; same contract but too thin to anchor on. No Polymarket/Kalshi/bookmaker market found. Analyst consensus is ~$108.7B, which typically trails guidance.

- Q2 FY27 (ended Jul 26, 2026): revenue $96.2B, +106% YoY, +18% QoQ; Data Center $89.0B (Nvidia PR via stocktitan/webull, Aug 26, 2026).
- Q2 FY27 prior guidance midpoint was $91.0B -> actual beat midpoint by $5.2B (+5.7%) (financial-news.co.uk, Aug 2026).
- Q3 FY27 guidance: $108B ±2% ($105.8B-$110.2B), GM ~74%, assumes no China DC compute revenue (Nvidia PR, Aug 26, 2026).
- Pre-report street estimate for Q3 had been $104.2B; post-guide consensus ~$108.7B (TipRanks, Oct 2026).
- Report date reportedly Nov 17, 2026 after close (TipRanks); some sources say Nov 18. Before the resolution date.
- Historical beats vs guide midpoint (from memory, approx): Q2 FY26 +3.8% ($46.7B vs $45B), Q3 FY26 +5.6% ($57.0B vs $54B), Q4 FY26 ~+4.8% ($68.1B vs $65B), Q1 FY27 ~+4-5%, Q2 FY27 +5.7%.
- Taiwan supply chain: Sep 2026 record revenues across Taiwanese listed companies; Dehong (quartz fiber cloth, Rubin) Q3 +250% YoY (Yahoo TW/UDN, Oct 11-12, 2026). Signals the Rubin ramp.
- Downside candidates: supply constraints (CoWoS, HBM), Rubin transition timing, export controls. Upside candidates: faster Rubin ramp, China H20-type sales resuming (not in guide).
- Status quo: revenue lands modestly above the guidance midpoint, as in every recent quarter.
- Resolution instrument: Nvidia's reported total revenue for Q3 FY27 (quarter ending ~Oct 25, 2026), first reported after Sep 2026.
- Event window: report expected ~Nov 17, 2026; as of Oct 12, 2026 the fiscal quarter is ~85% elapsed and the report has not happened.
- Searched for but not found: Kalshi/Polymarket markets on this figure; a whisper number.

The Vera Rubin ramp (~$20B expected this quarter) and record September revenue at Taiwanese suppliers support a normal-to-strong beat, but ramp timing is a two-sided risk. Exceeding $116B needs a beat above 7.4%, last seen in FY25: ~9%. Below $105B would mean landing under the guidance range: ~1%. calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: $108B ±2% guidance, beat history of 2.6-5.7% over 6 quarters, Q2 FY27 $96.2B vs $91B guide, report around Nov 17-18 (before the Nov 25 resolution), resolving on total revenue. The only factual discrepancy, Nov 17 vs Nov 18, does not affect the outcome and was not settled. The remaining disagreements are judgment calls: upper-escape mass (7-10%) and lower-tail placement (p10 110.0-111.0B). I would bet on a recent-cadence beat (~4.6%) with mild upside skew from Rubin, giving a median of $113.0B and 9% above $116B. I carry forward the shared reference class and a dispersion of ~$4.4B, consistent with runs 1 and 3. No web access on this run; nothing retrieved.

9%: beats >7.4% occurred in FY25 but not in the last 6 quarters; the Rubin ramp adds upside
~$110.6B: a low-end recent beat (2.6-3.8%) plus Rubin timing risk
